
### WHAT SOME OF THE FIELD NAMES MEAN
mean_pmv -- the mean PMV recorded for the represented observations; it does not establish a comfort judgment or a target
mean_residual_c -- the mean residual value recorded for the represented observations; it does not establish a control direction or target
pmv_h -- how far comfort went past the band, summed over the time it was past. Sizes excursions; not when they happened
program_version -- the program-version label recorded with a result; it does not establish result quality or control suitability
zone_h -- how long comfort spent outside the band. Counts time, not depth
